description: This file defines a Logger class for logging messages with various levels (verbose, debug, info, warning, error, wtf) and manages log storage and retrieval. It also supports setting a custom log provider and formatting log messages.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A utility class for logging messages at various levels, managing log storage, and providing log retrieval functions.

methods.name: setLogProvider
methods.description: Sets the external LogProvider used for logging.

methods.name: getAllLogLinesList
methods.description: Retrieves all log lines as a list of strings.

methods.name: getAllLogLines
methods.description: Retrieves all log lines concatenated into a single string.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional formatting.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional formatting.

methods.name: yell
methods.description: Logs a message at the 'YELL' level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional formatting.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional formatting.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional formatting.

methods.name: getStackTrace
methods.description: Converts a Throwable's stack trace into a string.
